'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike [[Zaporizhzhia]], killing two [[civilian]]s and injuring another, as well as damaging [[infrastructure]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-29-23/h_ff7059c98272cc600b14ba8e034a8810 (CNN International)]
***Two people are killed and 20 injured in a Russian missile strike on civilian infrastructure in [[Sumy]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/update-2-killed-20-injured-in-russian-attack-on-sumy/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Sungai Kolok fireworks disaster]]
**At least 12 people are killed and more than 115 others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a [[fireworks]] warehouse in [[Su-ngai Kolok]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/29/several-killed-in-thailand-firework-warehouse-explosion (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
**Another [[firefighter]] is killed while combating a [[wildfire]] near [[Fort St. John, British Columbia|Fort St. John]], [[British Columbia]], marking the third firefighter death in [[Canada]]'s wildfire season this year. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/third-firefighter-dies-battling-massive-blazes-in-canada (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]], [[Foreign relations of Haiti]], [[Foreign relations of Kenya]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs (Kenya)|Kenyan foreign minister]] [[Alfred Mutua]] announces [[Kenya|the country]]'s plan to deploy 1,000 [[Kenya Police|police officers]] to [[Haiti]], leading a [[multinational force]] to assist local [[Law enforcement in Haiti|law enforcement]] and restoring stability, pending [[Mandate (international law)|mandate]] approval from the [[United Nations Security Council]] and local authorities. [https://www.voanews.com/a/kenya-says-its-ready-to-lead-multinational-force-in-haiti-/7203781.html (AFP via VOA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[National Police of Colombia|Colombian police]] arrest the son of [[President of Colombia|President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] and his ex-wife on charges of [[money laundering]] and [[illicit enrichment]] related to the alleged acceptance of funds from [[Illegal drug trade in Colombia|drug traffickers]] during [[Gustavo Petro 2022 presidential campaign|Petro's 2022 presidential campaign]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230729-colombian-president-s-son-arrested-on-money-laundering-charges (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Indonesian National Police|Indonesian police]] announce the arrest of three [[Bali]]-based [[immigration officer]]s linked to an illicit [[organ trade]] network accused of [[Human trafficking in Indonesia|trafficking]] 122 individuals to [[Cambodia]] for [[Nephrectomy|nephrectomies]] and selling their [[kidney]]s, earning an estimated [[Indonesian rupiah|IDR]] 24.4 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]1.58 million) since 2019. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/three-bali-immigration-officers-arrested-over-cambodia-organ-trafficking-ring-3663686 (AFP via CNA)]
*[[Iran]] announces that it will try 104 members of the [[People's Mujahedin of Iran]] [[Trial in absentia|in absentia]], including its leader [[Maryam Rajavi]], who is in [[exile]] in [[Albania]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230729/00976e8996c1496bb6770dfccb76dd73/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Former [[President of Nigeria|Nigerian president]] [[Olusegun Obasanjo]] facilitates an agreement between opposing [[Politics of Kenya|Kenyan political]] alliances [[Azimio la Umoja]] and [[Kenya Kwanza]] in order to establish a joint committee aimed at resolving their "differences" following a series of violent protests against the [[Government of Kenya|government]] of [[President of Kenya|President]] [[William Ruto]]. [https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/news/kenyan-opposition-says-reached-talks-deal-wit-NV_166239 (AFP via ''New Vision'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 World Aquatics Championships]]
**[[Swimming in the United States|American swimmer]] [[Katie Ledecky]] surpasses fellow American [[Michael Phelps]] for [[List of World Championships records in swimming|the most individual gold medals]] at the [[FINA World Aquatics Championships|World Aquatics Championships]] after winning the gold in the [[Swimming at the 2023 World Aquatics Championships – Women's 800 metre freestyle|women's 800 meter freestyle competition]] of the 2023 edition in [[Fukuoka]], Japan. [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/katie-ledecky-breaks-michael-phelps-record-worlds-gold-medal-800-meter-freestyle (Fox News)]
